<!-- 
تعليمات للنموذج الذكي (LLM):
قم بملء النموذج أدناه. استبدل جميع العلامات `[ ... ]` أو المساحات الفارغة بمحتوى المشروع ذي الصلة. استخدم `parameters.md` كمرجع.
-->

Type.guidance: Document the type or category of the issue, such as stakeholder issue, technical issue, conflict, etc.

Issue description.guidance: Provide a detailed description of the issue.

الأولوية.guidance: Define the priority, such as urgent, high, medium, or low.

Impact on objectives.guidance: Identify the project objectives that the issue impacts and the degree of impact.

Responsible party.guidance: Identify the person who is assigned to resolve the issue.

الحالة.guidance: Denote the status of the issue as open or closed.

Resolution date.guidance: Document the date by which the issue needs to be resolved.

Final resolution.guidance: Describe how the issue was resolved.

التعليقات.guidance: Document any clarifying comments about the issue, resolution, or other fields on the form.
